correctness.rationale: Single-fixed-point conditioning gives an exact uniform injection. The binomial selections specify a UNIQUE assignment for each pattern, yielding the correctly normalized covariance formula. Rank k=2 follows a bidiagonal two-sided pivot argument. For k=3 the pattern-swap determinant is \(2(n-2)(3j^2-3jn+n^2-1)>0\), forcing the three local coefficients to vanish; overlapping triple windows cover all n positions. Every length-k row span for k>3 contains all triple-pattern rows by restricting/aggregating k-patterns. Exhaustive exact-rational direct enumeration checked 482297 covariance cells through n=8, 41 ranks to n=12, and 124251 determinant instances through n=500. Computations alone do not prove the infinite case.

value.rationale: The result determines the SHARP minimal consecutive ordinal window length whose second-order indicators detect every labeled fixed-point contrast. At length two the rank is n-1; at length three and every larger length it jumps to n, with a natural explicit finite-size kernel. The new full rank is not a renamed known descent covariance: it comes from jointly ordered three-position patterns and a positive local determinant. This resolves a structurally motivated finite-size statistical information question without asserting sample recovery.
